flowing.jungian: Conscious purpose and the feeling life are on speaking terms: what the ego wills, the inner child does not sabotage. Integration comes cheaply here — which is its own subtle danger, since what is never fought for is rarely examined.
flowing.mundane: Home life and career goals rarely collide; decisions tend to be backed by mood rather than undermined by it. Others read this person as self-consistent, and doors open on that account.
flowing.energy: A standing resonance between the solar and lunar currents: energy invested in identity feeds emotional reserves and vice versa. Across the progressions this shows as unusually smooth transitions between life chapters.
flowing.minimal: Wants and needs mostly agree. Low internal friction; consistency is a strength, complacency the associated risk.

challenge.jungian: What the ego sets out to become and what the soul actually needs pull in different directions — the parental imagos disagree inside. The friction is productive: this is a chart that must earn its self-knowledge, and usually does.
challenge.mundane: Career and home, image and comfort, partner and family repeatedly demand choices. Life tends to alternate between advancing outwardly and retreating to repair; scheduling both on purpose beats being yanked between them.
challenge.energy: The solar and lunar currents run out of phase: peaks of purposeful output coincide with troughs of emotional reserve. Learning one’s own cycle — and not reading its low points as failure — converts the interference into range.
challenge.minimal: Wants and needs disagree. Expect recurring identity-versus-comfort choices; managed deliberately, the tension gives depth.

neutral.jungian: Will and need are fused at birth — a new-moon signature. Enormous self-coherence, but little inner counter-voice: other people must often supply the perspective the psyche does not generate internally.
neutral.mundane: Purpose and preference point the same way, giving strong momentum along one track. Second opinions are worth institutionalising, because the internal devil’s advocate is quiet.
neutral.energy: Both primary currents surge and ebb together, like a spring tide: high highs, low lows, and a fresh-start quality after each trough. The cycle rewards clean beginnings.
neutral.minimal: Wants and needs are the same thing. Strong momentum, weak internal cross-check.

flowing.jungian: The senex blesses the ego rather than blocking it: authority is something to grow into, not fight. Self-discipline feels native, and mentors appear when needed.
flowing.mundane: Advancement comes steadily through competence and reliability; institutions tend to reward rather than frustrate. Late bloomer in the best sense — position compounds with age.
flowing.energy: The identity current runs in a well-engineered channel: less splash, more head of pressure. Long projects suit this signature; output per decade is remarkable.
flowing.minimal: Discipline comes easily and pays. Reliable, cumulative, unglamorous progress.

challenge.jungian: The inner judge sits across the table from the ego and grades its every act — often an internalised father or authority whose standards were never quite reachable. The work of maturity is to take the judge’s seat oneself: same rigour, chosen purpose.
challenge.mundane: Authority figures, gatekeepers and institutions loom large and often disappoint or delay. Achievements are real but feel harder-won than others’; imposter feelings persist after the evidence is in. Both ease markedly after the first Saturn return.
challenge.energy: The vital current meets high impedance: bursts of self-assertion are followed by contraction and doubt. Worked steadily, the resistance builds unusual load-bearing capacity — this is strength training, not punishment.
challenge.minimal: Self-worth is argued with an inner critic. Achievement is real, enjoyment lags. Improves substantially with age.

neutral.jungian: Ego and senex share one seat: identity is responsibility, from early on. The gift is gravity and trustworthiness; the shadow is a childhood shortened by seriousness that adulthood must consciously repay with play.
neutral.mundane: Duty arrives early — eldest-child energy regardless of birth order. Career and reputation are built carefully and defended; frivolity has to be scheduled.
neutral.energy: The identity current is permanently banked and channelled: steady, dense, slow to divert. Momentum, once gained, is nearly unstoppable — gaining it is the work.
neutral.minimal: Identity and duty fused. Serious, durable, slow-starting; lighten deliberately.

flowing.jungian: Feeling and structure cooperate: emotion arrives already contained, without being suppressed. This is the psyche of the reliable confidant — able to hold others’ weather because its own is held.
flowing.mundane: Emotional steadiness reads as maturity and earns trust early; responsibilities involving care or stewardship gravitate here. Home is run well and provides genuine ballast.
flowing.energy: The lunar current runs banked and steady — fewer floods, fewer droughts. Emotional stamina is the signature: this system endures what scatters others.
flowing.minimal: Feelings are steady and contained without being cold. Dependable; low drama.

challenge.jungian: The stern inner witness stands over the moon-child: needs were schooled early by duty, scarcity or a serious household, and adult feeling arrives pre-inspected. The task is to let Saturn serve feeling — containment as craft — rather than police it.
challenge.mundane: Care was rationed or conditional somewhere back there; the adult under-asks for comfort and over-delivers duty. Partnerships warm considerably once needing something is no longer treated as an imposition.
challenge.energy: The lunar current runs through a narrow, high-pressure channel: feelings build in long arcs and release late. Saturn’s 29.5-year cycle renovates the dam — each return, what was constriction can be rebuilt as capacity.
challenge.minimal: Feelings are controlled, delayed, dependable. Tendency to under-ask for comfort. Improves markedly with age.

neutral.jungian: The feeling nature is fused with the archetype of limit: emotion and obligation were never separate experiences. Loyalty is profound; spontaneity is the learned skill.
neutral.mundane: Family came with duties attached, and adult home life is organised around reliability. Excellent in crises; remember that ease, too, is allowed.
neutral.energy: Need and structure pulse as one current — security is not a backdrop here but the medium itself. Slow to trust, then permanent.
neutral.minimal: Need and duty fused. Deeply loyal, slow to open, permanent once given.

flowing.jungian: Anima and animus cooperate: desire and affection flow in the same channel without shorting. Attraction is expressed cleanly and received as charm rather than pressure.
flowing.mundane: Courtship, negotiation and creative work all benefit from warmth that can act and action that stays warm. Socially effective; commercially useful.
flowing.energy: The receptive and active currents are phase-matched — build and release cycle smoothly in love and in craft. Sustainable heat rather than flare and ash.
flowing.minimal: Desire and affection cooperate. Direct, warm, effective in love and creative work.

challenge.jungian: Desire and affection contradict: what is wanted and what is valued point at different objects, or at the same object in incompatible ways. Projection is vivid here — the exciting one and the good one seem to be different people until the split is owned as internal.
challenge.mundane: Relationships run hot-and-cold; timing in love is chronically off by a beat — advances at the wrong moment, hesitation at the right one. Awareness of the rhythm, and saying it aloud, defuses most of it.
challenge.energy: The receptive and active currents interfere: attraction spikes when availability dips and vice versa. The pattern is the energy source — couples and creations born of this signature have durable heat once the phase difference is worked with, not against.
challenge.minimal: Wanting and valuing clash. Hot-cold rhythm in love; name it openly and it settles.

neutral.jungian: Eros undivided: loving and wanting are a single act. Magnetic and creative, with the shadow that partners can feel consumed rather than met — the pause between impulse and approach is where relatedness lives.
neutral.mundane: Attraction is acted on promptly; this person courts, initiates, and does best where pursuit is welcome. Strong aesthetic drive — good for enterprises where taste must be executed, not just felt.
neutral.energy: Attraction and action fire as one pulse. Fast ignition, real charisma; consciously lengthening the release phase keeps partners in phase.
neutral.minimal: Desire and affection are one impulse. Direct in love; occasionally too fast for the other person.

flowing.jungian: The wound sits beside the ego rather than inside its core: pain is available as material for self-knowledge without dominating the self-image. Natural mentor territory — credibility with the hurting comes without having to bleed for it daily.
flowing.mundane: Helping, teaching and healing roles come easily and suit the identity. Others confide readily; the trick is billing for what feels effortless.
flowing.energy: The identity current and the wound signature resonate gently — access to depth without collapse into it. Energy spent on others’ healing genuinely recharges rather than drains.
flowing.minimal: The wound informs identity without running it. Natural mentor; underprices the gift.

challenge.jungian: The wound crosses the ego’s path: somewhere early, being seen and being hurt got entangled, and self-expression still braces for the old sting. The wounded-healer arc applies in full — mastery comes precisely in the domain of the injury, but only after the injury is related to consciously instead of compensated.
challenge.mundane: Confidence is the visible issue: qualifications outrun self-presentation, and moments of exposure (promotion, performance, publication) reactivate old shame out of proportion. Each deliberate exposure shrinks the effect; avoidance feeds it.
challenge.energy: The identity current shorts through an old lesion when amplitude rises — visibility spikes trigger energy crashes. Repeated, titrated exposure rewires the pathway; the healed circuit carries more current than an unbroken one would have.
challenge.minimal: Being seen hurts more than it should. The skill grows exactly where the flinch is. Exposure in small doses works.

neutral.jungian: Identity and wound share a root: “who I am” and “where it hurts” answer to the same name. This is the strongest healer signature of all — and the one most required to do its own work first.
neutral.mundane: Life keeps assigning the mentor role whether requested or not. Formalising it — training, credentials, boundaries — turns a leak into a profession.
neutral.energy: The core current runs through the wound, not beside it: every act of self-becoming touches it, every healing enlarges the self. Slow, cumulative, profound.
neutral.minimal: Self and wound are one address. Heavy signature, big yield: the healer’s path, obligatory rather than optional.

flowing.jungian: Feeling has access to the wound without being flooded by it: this psyche can sit with pain — its own and others’ — and remain warm. Emotional wisdom beyond what experience alone explains.
flowing.mundane: People bring their troubles here and leave lighter. Caring professions and confidant roles fit; boundaries keep the gift sustainable.
flowing.energy: The lunar current flows around the wound like water around a stone — aware of it, shaped by it, not blocked. Grief metabolises unusually well.
flowing.minimal: Comfortable with pain, own and others’. Wise, warm, sought out. Guard the boundaries.

challenge.jungian: The wound sits in the needing place: early nurture came with a sting or an absence, and adult neediness reactivates the original ache. The reflex is to mother everyone else. The healing is to let oneself be mothered — clumsily, incrementally, in real relationships.
challenge.mundane: Asking for comfort feels dangerous, so care flows one way — outward — until depletion forces the issue. Partnerships improve sharply when the deal is renegotiated aloud.
challenge.energy: The lunar current snags on an old lesion each time need rises: intake valves close exactly when the tank is lowest. Practising reception in small, safe doses re-opens the channel.
challenge.minimal: Needing feels unsafe; caring for others substitutes. Learn to receive. Small doses count.

neutral.jungian: Need and wound are fused: to feel at all is to touch the tender place. Immense compassion is the flower of it; the root work is distinguishing today’s feeling from the original injury wearing its clothes.
neutral.mundane: Home and family history carry the ache; the adult household can either re-run it or consciously re-write it. Choose the second, on purpose, in writing if necessary.
neutral.energy: The feeling current and the wound signature share one waveform — every emotional tide washes the same shore. Each conscious cycle deposits a little more healed ground.
neutral.minimal: Feeling and wound share a nerve. Compassion is native; sorting past from present is the discipline.

flowing.jungian: Structure serves healing: the wound is given scaffolding — practice, method, patience — and repays with authority that no credential confers.
flowing.mundane: The long apprenticeship pays off: skills built slowly around an old difficulty become a durable, respected competence. Teaching and standards work suit.
flowing.energy: Discipline and healing run in phase: regular, modest work on the sore point compounds like interest. Nothing dramatic, everything cumulative.
flowing.minimal: Method applied to the wound works. Slow, structural, permanent gains.

challenge.jungian: The inner judge guards the wound and calls the arrangement realism: hurt is met with “cope harder” rather than care. The two must be introduced — rigour in service of the injury, not instead of tending it.
challenge.mundane: Health, confidence or old grief are managed by gritted teeth until the structure cracks; the crack, when it comes, is the invitation. Getting help early is cheaper — literally and otherwise.
challenge.energy: The containment current clamps the healing current: pressure without release. Scheduled release — therapy, ritual, hard conversation — turns a slow leak into maintenance.
challenge.minimal: Coping substitutes for healing until it can’t. Get help before the crack, not after.

neutral.jungian: The wound and the law are one lesson: what hurt also disciplined, and what disciplines still carries the hurt’s signature. The elder this chart is growing — patient, unshockable, exact — is built from precisely this material.
neutral.mundane: Responsibility arrived through difficulty, early. The resulting competence is real; so is the entitlement to put the load down sometimes.
neutral.energy: Wound and structure share one slow frequency — Saturn and Chiron’s long cycles interleave, and their conjunctions and returns mark the chapters where the material is reworked at a higher turn.
neutral.minimal: Hurt and duty grew together. Competence is the scar tissue; rest is allowed.

flowing.jungian: Feeling has a staircase to the depths: intensity is available without possession. Emotional honesty of an unusual grade — this psyche does not pretend, and detects pretence instantly.
flowing.mundane: Crises reveal this person’s value: where others flinch, they function. Trusted with secrets and with the sickbed; drawn to work at the thresholds.
flowing.energy: The lunar current runs deep and regenerates fast — emotional composting: losses break down into fertility on an accelerated cycle.
flowing.minimal: Deep feelings, well-plumbed. Unshockable, honest, good in crisis.

challenge.jungian: Feeling and the depths grip each other: emotion arrives at survival intensity, and attachment carries a fear of engulfment or abandonment that predates memory. The work is titration — letting feeling be strong without letting it be total — and the yield is emotional power that can hold anything.
challenge.mundane: Intimacy runs hot: jealousy, testing, all-or-nothing turns. Power struggles at home repeat until the pattern is named as pattern; then the same intensity becomes fierce, reliable devotion.
challenge.energy: The lunar current periodically floods from below — old material surges up under new triggers. Each worked flood dredges the channel deeper and calmer; unworked, the same water returns.
challenge.minimal: Feelings arrive at full intensity with old roots. Name the pattern; the intensity then serves instead of ruling.

neutral.jungian: Need is fused with the transformative depths: to be emotionally touched is to be changed. Relationships are metamorphic events here, never furniture.
neutral.mundane: Family history holds buried material — things not spoken — and this person is the one who digs. Excavation done with care frees the generation after.
neutral.energy: The feeling current cycles through death-and-rebirth phases as its normal weather. Others should not set their clocks by this tide, but should respect it.
neutral.minimal: To feel is to be transformed. Heavy weather, real renewal, no small talk.
